messages:
alex: quick idea after the sync: instead of exposing raw bitwidths, expose "fidelity_lane" in the runtime. lanes: high/mid/low. runtime maps lane -> artifact + admission policy. keeps UX stable for customers.

lina: like an abstraction layer for ops. how do we prevent oscillation when quality bounces around?

alex: add hysteresis + cool-down. e.g., if mid->high switch on degradation score >0.10 for 3m, require score <0.05 for 10m to drop back. simpler than per-request flip-flopping.

chen: what produces the degradation score? need concrete signals. suggestion: combined metric = 0.6*eval_f1 + 0.3*perplexity_norm + 0.1*late_token_confidence_drop. normalized 0..1, lower is worse.

noah: ops/infra: also factor in token-cost delta. if switching to high doubles cost we should gate by budget window. maybe lane resolution includes cost_budget_pct and max_ramp.

alex: agreed. lane resolution returns {artifact, expected_cost_multiplier, rps_limit, allowed_override}. runtime enforces rps_limit and rate-limits overrides.

priya: for customer SLAs we need per-tenant policy. allow tenancy overrides in catalog with inheritance from global lanes. But any tenant override must be audit-logged and visible in cost dashboards.

lina: rollout plan idea: 1) support lane field in request + endpoint config; 2) implement server-side mapping + cache; 3) shadow sampling: route 5% of mid lane to high artifact and compute degradation score without impacting production; 4) canary 1% forced overrides; 5) scale.

alex: good. config example for catalog entry: 
```json
{
  "model":"rwd-v3",
  "version":"2026-03-20",
  "lanes":{
    "high":{"artifact":"rwd-v3-fp8","cost_mult":"1.9","rps_limit":500},
    "mid":{"artifact":"rwd-v3-int8","cost_mult":"1.0","rps_limit":1000},
    "low":{"artifact":"rwd-v3-4bit","cost_mult":"0.6","rps_limit":2000}
  }
}
```

chen: we should also annotate artifacts with compatibility tags: kv-safe, longctx-optimized, beam-safe. mapping can prefer kv-safe for longctx requests.

noah: metric plumbing: emit `lane_chosen`, `lane_resolution_latency_ms`, `degradation_score`, `cost_mult_applied`, `override_flag`. tag by tenant, endpoint, model. add alert if 5m p95 cost_mult_applied > 1.5 for any tenant.

priya: billing: attach billing_label = f"lane:{lane}" to tokens so chargeback is straightforward. also track shadow-sample costs separately so we can A/B cost/quality.

lina: edgecases: existing artifacts named with bitwidths. make catalog support legacy mapping and an automated migration tool that suggests neutral artifact names.

alex: ops ACLs: only certain roles can set endpoint defaults. request-level overrides require entitlement and will be rate-limited and billed at higher rate.

priya: for experiments, add `lane_experiment` header to force sampling without affecting production path; must be opt-in per-tenant.

deploy-bot: deploy started: fidelity-lanes-mvp -> staging (canary 5%).

noah: next actions: write short RFC describing schema changes, metric names, migration script, and a canary playbook w/ rollback triggers (degradation_score > 0.12 OR cost_spike > 2x for 10m). i'll prototype the histogram for degradation_score.

alex: i'll draft RFC and include CLI examples for `catalog set-lane` and `catalog migrate-legacy-artifacts`. thanks all. :thumbsup:
